name: agent-memory
description: Agent Memory — creates and maintains a .claude/ folder at the project root as persistent, stack-agnostic AI memory: an INDEX, AGENT rules/state, a SESSION index (linking to one file per session in sessions/), a TASKS index (linking to one file per task in tasks/), ARCHITECTURE, CODEBASE_MAP, a DECISIONS index (linking to one file per ADR in DECISIONS/), and optional CONTEXT/ files (api, auth, database, frontend). Uses a progressive-disclosure design (slim core SKILL.md + on-demand references/) for low token use. Works across C#, C++, Python, Go, React, Next.js, Blazor, Ruby, Java, Rust, and other stacks.
